purpose: Govern the intentional accumulation and resolution of provisional knowledge, assumptions, shortcuts, undefined concepts, and incomplete formalizations across the Mono-Process Framework.
definition: Research Debt is knowingly accepted incompleteness that enables continued program progress while creating an obligation for future resolution.

governance.rule: All intentional incompleteness SHALL be registered. Unregistered debt SHALL NOT be relied upon for promotion.

debt_types.description: Definition exists but lacks sufficient validation.
Expected theorem or lemma not yet established.
Knowledge exists but is not formally documented.
Required governance policy has not yet been established.
Known tool invocation, packaging, or environment behavior gap that affects governed execution without changing theory claims.

debt_items.title: Incomplete DB governance runtime views and routing
debt_items.reason_accepted: The DB now exposes runtime decision logging, patch gating, current-state querying, and authority resolution for known surfaces. Deeper semantic projections and residue compression remain open.
blocks: DB-first patch gating as a complete runtime
required_resolution: Extend current-state routing into deeper semantic RT projection
debt_items.notes: This debt is partially resolved by the current-state capsule and authority-resolution surface; the remaining work is the deeper semantic projection layer.

debt_items.title: Deeper semantic RT, authority, and debt projections for the DB current-state capsule
debt_items.reason_accepted: The runtime now returns a current-state capsule and a target-aware authority resolution surface, and freshness separates source-affecting changes from runtime-only DB churn using distinct markers, but the DB still does not project the full semantic authority graph, full claim-to-evidence reasoning, or residue compression deeply enough to replace broader registry inspection.
debt_items.notes: This follow-on debt remains partially resolved after the current-state capsule, snapshot-refresh metadata, refresh-stability marker split, and semantic authority mapping landed. Runtime-only DB churn is no longer treated as source drift for freshness, but the deeper semantic claim-evidence and residue projections remain open.

debt_items.title: Runtime patch-chain resolution and dependency-bound patch classification
debt_items.reason_accepted: The runtime now needs target-aware patch-chain resolution so patch application can be classified as active, blocked, missing, superseded, late-registered, or dependency-bound before execution. The chain surface is present, but deeper provenance coverage and registry fallback handling remain open.
required_resolution: Add registry fallback for missing patches
debt_items.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-05 by the live patch-chain command, patch-gate integration, dependency-bound classification, and registry fallback handling already present in the DB governance runtime.

debt_items.title: Runtime debt projection and debt-aware patch gating
debt_items.reason_accepted: The runtime now exposes a debt command, debt-aware patch-gate consulting, and an explicit snapshot refresh procedure with precise stale-state diagnosis, but deeper semantic debt projection and claim-evidence compression remain open.
required_resolution: Persist debt projection refresh in the runtime
debt_items.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-05 by the live debt command, debt-aware patch-gate consulting, status-filtered debt summaries, and the snapshot-refresh path already documented in the runtime.

debt_items.title: Runtime context capsule projection and agent-facing compression
debt_items.reason_accepted: The runtime now composes a compact context capsule and exposes a dedicated query command, but deeper target-specific compression and semantic projection remain open.
required_resolution: Document the capsule as the preferred runtime entrypoint
Keep the capsule derived at request time
debt_items.notes: Resolved on 2026-07-05 by the live context-capsule command and preferred-entrypoint documentation already present in the DB governance runtime.

debt_items.title: Governance event replay scaffold, diagnostic reconciliation, and event-sourced state reconstruction
debt_items.reason_accepted: The runtime now captures, queries, bounded-replays, and reconciles append-only governance events against registry authority, but deeper event-sourced reconstruction remains incomplete.
required_resolution: Preserve diagnostic-only replay and reconciliation boundaries
Keep full semantic replay reconstruction open
debt_items.notes: Event capture, query, bounded replay, and diagnostic reconciliation are live; full semantic replay reconstruction remains unresolved.

design_principles: Debt must eventually be resolved, retired, or explicitly accepted.
